title: Why Pitraya Rituals Exists — Restoring Transparency & Dignity to Gaya Pilgrimage
metaDescription: The founding story of Pitraya Rituals — why we built this company, what problems we solve in Gaya pilgrimage, and our commitment to transparent pricing, verified Gayawal Pandits, and authentic Vedic rites.
author: Pitraya Rituals Founding Team
summary: Pitraya Rituals was born from a simple observation: the most sacred ancestral pilgrimage in Hinduism was suffering from opacity, overcharging, and lack of coordination. We built Pitraya to change that.
content:
Every year, over 5 lakh pilgrims travel to Gaya to perform Pind Daan for their departed ancestors. Yet for decades, the experience was marred by:

- **Unverified touts** intercepting families at the railway station and airport
- **Opaque pricing** with no transparent package structure
- **Incomplete ceremonies** rushed without proper Vedic procedure
- **Lost Vamsavali records** with no family-specific lineage tracking
- **Language barriers** for NRI families unfamiliar with ritual protocols

Pitraya Rituals was founded by a team of technologists and Vedic scholars who experienced these problems firsthand during their own family Pind Daan journeys.

### Our Mission Statement
*To restore transparency, dignity, and spiritual completeness to every Gaya Pind Daan pilgrimage — by combining technology with generational Gayawal Purohit expertise.*

### What We Guarantee
1. **Hereditary Gayawal Purohit** — every family is assigned a verified, lineage-authenticated Tirth Purohit with a documented Gaya registration number.
2. **Fixed Transparent Pricing** — packages published on our website include all services with zero hidden additions.
3. **Complete Ritual Coverage** — all 45 Gaya Dhaams included in Premium packages, with no ritual shortcuts.
4. **Digital Record-Keeping** — Vamsavali lineage entries digitized and securely stored for your family.
5. **Post-Ceremony Support** — WhatsApp access to your Purohit for 30 days for any follow-up ritual questions.

sections.heading: What Services We Provide
sections.body: Pitraya Rituals offers end-to-end Gaya Pind Daan packages including: Gayawal Tirth Purohit coordination, complete Vedic samagri, AC hotel accommodation near Vishnupad Temple, private vehicle transfers, all 45 Dhaam rites, Vamsavali registry entry, puja photograph documentation, and post-ceremony digital certificate.

sections.heading: Our Promise to Every Family
sections.body: We treat every pilgrimage as if it is our own family's ceremony. We will never rush, never skip, and never compromise on the authenticity and completeness of your ancestral rites. Pitru Devadbhyah — Ancestors are our first Gods.

faqs.question: Is Pitraya Rituals affiliated with any Gayawal Purohit association?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pitraya Rituals works exclusively with verified members of the Gaya Tirth Purohit Mahasabha and the Vishnupad Temple Trust-registered Gayawal families.

faqs.question: How do you ensure the Pind Daan is performed correctly?
faqs.answer: Every ceremony is conducted per Apastamba Pitru Medha Sutras and Gayawal Parampara standards. Our Purohits undergo regular review by senior Acharyas. Every ceremony is photographed and documented.
